materials.summary_zh: 一位上班族讲述自己工作日的早晨：几点起床、吃什么、怎么去上班。

segments.en: My name is David, and I work in an office.
segments.zh: 我叫大卫，在一家公司上班。

segments.en: From Monday to Friday, I get up at half past six.
segments.zh: 周一到周五，我六点半起床。

segments.en: First, I take a shower and get dressed.
segments.zh: 首先，我洗个澡，穿好衣服。

segments.en: Then I have breakfast with my wife.
segments.zh: 然后我和妻子一起吃早饭。

segments.en: We usually have eggs, bread and a cup of coffee.
segments.zh: 我们通常吃鸡蛋、面包，喝一杯咖啡。

segments.en: At half past seven, I leave home.
segments.zh: 七点半，我出门。

segments.en: I go to work by bus, and the trip takes thirty minutes.
segments.zh: 我坐公交车去上班，路上要三十分钟。

segments.en: I read the news on my phone on the bus.
segments.zh: 在公交车上，我用手机看新闻。

segments.en: I start work at half past eight.
segments.zh: 我八点半开始工作。

segments.en: On Saturdays and Sundays, I get up late!
segments.zh: 周六和周日，我起得很晚！

questions.explanation_zh: 原文：I get up at half past six. half past six = 六点半。
原文：I go to work by bus.
原文：the trip takes thirty minutes。注意 thirty（30）和 thirteen（13）的区别。
原文：On Saturdays and Sundays, I get up late!

materials.summary_zh: 汤姆搬进新公寓，给朋友发消息介绍房子和周边。

segments.en: Hi Kate,
segments.zh: 嗨，凯特：

segments.en: I have a new flat!
segments.zh: 我有新公寓啦！

segments.en: It is small, but it is very bright.
segments.zh: 房子不大，但很亮堂。

segments.en: There is one bedroom, a living room and a small kitchen.
segments.zh: 有一间卧室、一个客厅和一个小厨房。

segments.en: There are two big windows in the living room.
segments.zh: 客厅里有两扇大窗户。

segments.en: My flat is on the third floor, and there is no lift.
segments.zh: 我住在三楼，没有电梯。

segments.en: There is a park near my building, so I can run in the morning.
segments.zh: 楼附近有个公园，所以我早上可以去跑步。

segments.en: There is also a supermarket across the street.
segments.zh: 街对面还有一家超市。

segments.en: Are you free on Saturday?
segments.zh: 你周六有空吗？

segments.en: Come and see it!
segments.zh: 过来看看吧！

segments.en: Tom
segments.zh: 汤姆

glossary.note_zh: 英式英语里 ground floor 是一楼，third floor 实际是四楼；这里按中文习惯译作三楼。

questions.prompt_zh: 汤姆的公寓有几间卧室？
questions.explanation_zh: 原文：There is one bedroom...

questions.prompt_zh: 关于这栋楼，哪一项是对的？
questions.explanation_zh: 原文：there is no lift.
原文：There is also a supermarket across the street.

questions.prompt_zh: 汤姆为什么写这条消息？
questions.explanation_zh: 结尾：Are you free on Saturday? Come and see it!

materials.summary_zh: 在楼道里遇到新搬来的邻居，聊住在哪一户、做什么工作。

segments.speaker: Grace
segments.en: Hi! Are you new here?
segments.zh: 嗨！你是新搬来的吗？

segments.speaker: Omar
segments.en: Yes, I am. I live in flat twelve.
segments.zh: 是的。我住十二号。

segments.speaker: Grace
segments.en: Oh, I live in flat fourteen. I'm Grace.
segments.zh: 哦，我住十四号。我是格蕾丝。

segments.speaker: Omar
segments.en: Nice to meet you, Grace. I'm Omar.
segments.zh: 很高兴认识你，格蕾丝。我是奥马尔。

segments.speaker: Grace
segments.en: Where are you from, Omar?
segments.zh: 奥马尔，你是哪里人？

segments.speaker: Omar
segments.en: I'm from Egypt, but I work here now.
segments.zh: 我是埃及人，不过现在在这里工作。

segments.speaker: Grace
segments.en: What do you do?
segments.zh: 你是做什么工作的？

segments.speaker: Omar
segments.en: I'm a nurse. I work at the hospital on King Street.
segments.zh: 我是护士，在国王街的医院上班。

segments.speaker: Grace
segments.en: Really? My sister works there, too!
segments.zh: 真的吗？我妹妹也在那儿上班！

segments.speaker: Omar
segments.en: Small world! Have a nice day.
segments.zh: 世界真小！祝你今天愉快。

glossary.note_zh: 问职业，不是问“你在做什么”。

questions.explanation_zh: 原文：I live in flat twelve.
原文：I'm a nurse.

questions.prompt_zh: 为什么奥马尔说 Small world?
options: 格蕾丝的妹妹和他在同一家医院工作
questions.explanation_zh: 格蕾丝说 My sister works there, too!

materials.summary_zh: 在市场买水果：问价格、说要多少、付钱。

segments.speaker: Seller
segments.en: Good morning! Can I help you?
segments.zh: 早上好！要买点什么？

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.en: Yes, please. How much are the apples?
segments.zh: 是的。苹果多少钱？

segments.speaker: Seller
segments.en: They're two pounds a kilo.
segments.zh: 两英镑一公斤。

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.en: OK. Can I have one kilo, please?
segments.zh: 好的。请给我一公斤。

segments.speaker: Seller
segments.en: Sure. Anything else?
segments.zh: 好的。还要别的吗？

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.en: Are the bananas fresh?
segments.zh: 香蕉新鲜吗？

segments.speaker: Seller
segments.en: Yes, they came this morning. They're one pound for six.
segments.zh: 新鲜，今天早上刚到。一英镑六根。

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.en: Great, I'll take six, please.
segments.zh: 太好了，我要六根。

segments.speaker: Seller
segments.en: That's three pounds altogether.
segments.zh: 一共三英镑。

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.en: Here you are. Thank you!
segments.zh: 给你。谢谢！

glossary.zh: 来了；到了（come 的过去式）

questions.explanation_zh: 原文：They're two pounds a kilo.
原文：I'll take six, please.
苹果 2 英镑 + 香蕉 1 英镑 = 3 英镑。原文：That's three pounds altogether.

materials.summary_zh: 艾米在罗马度假，给朋友写明信片：住在哪里、吃了什么、去了哪些地方。

segments.en: Hi Jess,
segments.zh: 嗨，杰斯：

segments.en: Greetings from Rome! I'm here with my sister for five days.
segments.zh: 来自罗马的问候！我和姐姐在这里待五天。

segments.en: Our hotel is small, but it's very near the centre.
segments.zh: 我们的酒店很小，但离市中心很近。

segments.en: Every morning we have coffee and a croissant in a little café.
segments.zh: 每天早上我们在一家小咖啡馆喝咖啡、吃羊角面包。

segments.en: Yesterday we visited an old church and walked by the river.
segments.zh: 昨天我们参观了一座古老的教堂，还沿着河边散步。

segments.en: The food is fantastic, and the ice cream is the best in the world!
segments.zh: 这里的食物棒极了，冰淇淋是世界上最好吃的！

segments.en: The weather is hot and sunny, so I'm wearing my new hat.
segments.zh: 天气又热又晴，所以我戴着我的新帽子。

segments.en: Tomorrow we're going to the museum.
segments.zh: 明天我们要去博物馆。

segments.en: See you next week!
segments.zh: 下周见！

segments.en: Love, Amy
segments.zh: 爱你的艾米

questions.explanation_zh: 原文：I'm here with my sister for five days.
原文：Our hotel is small, but it's very near the centre.
原文：Yesterday we visited an old church and walked by the river.
原文：Tomorrow we're going to the museum.

materials.title_en: Class Trip to the Science Museum
materials.title_zh: 去科学博物馆的班级出游
materials.summary_zh: 一份学校通知：出游的时间、要带什么、费用和表格什么时候交。

segments.en: Class 4B: school trip
segments.zh: 4B 班：学校出游

segments.en: Next Friday, our class is going to the Science Museum.
segments.zh: 下周五，我们班要去科学博物馆。

segments.en: The bus leaves school at half past eight, so please don't be late.
segments.zh: 大巴八点半从学校出发，请不要迟到。

segments.en: We will come back at about three o'clock in the afternoon.
segments.zh: 我们大约下午三点回来。

segments.en: Please bring a packed lunch and a bottle of water.
segments.zh: 请带上自己准备的午饭和一瓶水。

segments.en: You can't buy food at the museum.
segments.zh: 博物馆里买不到吃的。

segments.en: Wear comfortable shoes, because we will walk a lot.
segments.zh: 穿舒服的鞋，因为我们要走很多路。

segments.en: There is a gift shop, but you don't need to bring extra money.
segments.zh: 那里有礼品店，但不需要带额外的钱。

segments.en: The trip costs five pounds.
segments.zh: 这次出游要五英镑。

segments.en: Please give the money and the form to Mr Brown by Wednesday.
segments.zh: 请在周三之前把钱和表格交给布朗老师。

segments.en: Thank you!
segments.zh: 谢谢！

questions.explanation_zh: 原文：The bus leaves school at half past eight.
原文：You can't buy food at the museum.
原文：Wear comfortable shoes, because we will walk a lot.

questions.prompt_zh: 钱和表格要什么时候交？
questions.explanation_zh: 原文：Please give the money and the form to Mr Brown by Wednesday.

materials.summary_zh: 作者介绍认识了将近二十年的好朋友索菲亚：她的样子、工作和两人的友谊。

segments.en: My best friend is called Sofia.
segments.zh: 我最好的朋友叫索菲亚。

segments.en: We met at school when we were six.
segments.zh: 我们六岁时在学校认识。

segments.en: Now we are both twenty-five, and we are still friends.
segments.zh: 现在我们都二十五岁了，仍然是朋友。

segments.en: Sofia is tall and has short black hair.
segments.zh: 索菲亚个子高，留着黑色短发。

segments.en: She is very funny, and she always makes me laugh.
segments.zh: 她很幽默，总是逗我笑。

segments.en: She works in a hospital as a nurse.
segments.zh: 她在医院当护士。

segments.en: Her job is hard, but she loves it.
segments.zh: 她的工作很辛苦，但她很喜欢。

segments.en: We don't live in the same city now.
segments.zh: 我们现在不住在同一个城市。

segments.en: But we talk on the phone every Sunday evening.
segments.zh: 但是我们每周日晚上通电话。

segments.en: In the summer, we always go on holiday together.
segments.zh: 夏天我们总是一起去度假。

questions.prompt_zh: 她们是什么时候认识的？
questions.explanation_zh: 原文：We met at school when we were six.
原文：She works in a hospital as a nurse.
原文：we talk on the phone every Sunday evening.
原文：In the summer, we always go on holiday together.

materials.summary_zh: 玛丽亚贴出的寻物启事：背包丢在哪里、长什么样、里面有什么，找到了怎么联系她。

segments.en: Lost! Have you seen my backpack?
segments.zh: 丢失！你看到我的背包了吗？

segments.en: I lost my blue backpack on Tuesday afternoon.
segments.zh: 我周二下午丢了我的蓝色背包。

segments.en: I think I left it on the number 12 bus.
segments.zh: 我想我把它落在了 12 路公交车上。

segments.en: It has a small yellow star on the front.
segments.zh: 它前面有一颗黄色的小星星。

segments.en: Inside there is a laptop, two books and a black umbrella.
segments.zh: 里面有一台笔记本电脑、两本书和一把黑伞。

segments.en: The books are not mine; they are from the library!
segments.zh: 书不是我的，是图书馆的！

segments.en: If you find it, please call me on 07700 900123.
segments.zh: 如果你找到了，请打 07700 900123 联系我。

segments.en: You can also leave it at the café on King Street.
segments.zh: 你也可以把它放在国王街的咖啡馆。

segments.en: Thank you very much! Maria
segments.zh: 非常感谢！玛丽亚

glossary.zh: 落下；遗留（leave 的过去式）

questions.explanation_zh: 原文：I lost my blue backpack. 黄色的是背包上的星星。

questions.prompt_zh: 玛丽亚觉得背包丢在哪里了？
questions.explanation_zh: 原文：I think I left it on the number 12 bus.
原文：The books are not mine; they are from the library!

questions.prompt_zh: 找到背包的人可以怎么做？
options: 打电话，或者放到国王街的咖啡馆
questions.explanation_zh: 原文：please call me … You can also leave it at the café on King Street.
